description: Measured on this tree: a newline after `set :x to` does not continue. 2 statements (VarRef + NumberLit) — statement kinds measured but not mechanically asserted (see #1077). 2x `ol-bad-token` at parse stage. `check()` would additionally report `ol-undefined-var` for `:x`, but it is not reached under the harness's documented short-circuit (tests/conformance/README.md:80-82): when parse diagnostics exist, `check()` is not called.
